deployment_quality_annotation.label: broad-complete-optional-backend-environment
deployment_quality_annotation.detail: The program installs the editable project, scientific and documentation dependencies, CPU TensorFlow and Torch, and exact-revision optional Qibo backends. It copies TensorFlow's genuine generated experimental API into the same installed package so Pyright can discover an API that TensorFlow otherwise exposes dynamically; it does not create a synthetic provider or modify repository source.
deployment_quality_annotation.efficiency: The successful path required about 55 minutes of Agent generation, 737 seconds for internal clean qualification, 666 seconds for online Official execution, and 8.79 million input tokens.

infrastructure_notes: The first C1 attempt was adjudicated as infrastructure censoring before observing any T or C0 postepisode outcome and has a separate evidence record.
The generic classifier was deliberately not broadened for bare no-matching-distribution failures on ordinary dependencies, because those can represent real platform or version incompatibility.
The source-only exact-revision cache was used uniformly and did not contain generated environments, candidate scripts, or prior result trajectories.
